# Pororoca
> A fleet of AI agents that works for one person, so that person stops being the bottleneck. Pre-alpha, MIT.

- [Home](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/): the problem, the reference fleet's numbers and the plan
- [Agents](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/agents.html): the six starter agents and the optional ones, with their roles
- [Concepts](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/concepts.html): maloca, card, lane, gatekeeper, autonomy, chaser, jirau
- [maloca.yaml](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/spec/maloca.html): the team file, annotated key by key, and its compatibility with OpenRig
- [Adapter contracts](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/spec/adapters.html): the TypeScript ports
- [Integrations](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/integrations.html): the connector matrix
- [Safety](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/safety.html): shadow mode, autonomy, signature, embarrassment metric
- [Roadmap](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/roadmap.html): milestones M1 to M5 and the patterns from the reference fleet
- [Tour](https://cavalcanticampos.github.io/pororoca/tour.html): four scenes of a fleet at work
- [PRD](https://github.com/cavalcanticampos/pororoca/blob/main/docs/PRD.md)
